content: Ajenna n jdid d temmurt n jdid
Uca ẓriɣ ajenna n jdid d ict n temmurt n jdid, maɣar ajenna amezwaru d temmurt tamezwarut tuɣa ɛdun, řebḥar war iqqim ɛad.
Necc ẓriɣ tandint iqeddsen, Urcalim n jdid, tehwa-dd zeg ujenna zi zzat AREBBI, tegga am tesřit izehhjen i wesři.
Uca sřiɣ ict n tmijja tᵉttřaɣa-dd zeg ujenna s jjehd:
“Xẓar, Aqiḍun n AREBBI aqa-tt jar iwdan, uca Netta ad ɣarsen izdeɣ. Nitni ad iřin d řgens nnes, uca AREBBI simant nnes ad ɣarsen yiři, uca ad yiři d AREBBI nsen.
Ad asen issiẓeɣ kuř imeṭṭan zi tiṭṭawin nsen, uca war tᵉttiři ɛad řmewt d wecḍan d ucetci d řeḥriq.”
U xmi ggureɣ, inna ayi wenni iqqimen x řɛarc:
“Xẓar, ad ggeɣ marra d jdid!”
Xas uca inna ayi:
“Ari: Awařen-a aqa daysen řaman d tidett.”
Netta inna ayi:
“Aqa ittwakemmeř. Necc d Alif u Necc d Taw, Necc d Beddu d Akemmeř. Wenni iffuden ad as wceɣ ad isu baṭeř zi řɛunṣar n Waman n Tudart.
Wi ɣa iɣellben ad iwart man aya, uca Necc ad iřiɣ d AREBBI nnes, u netta ad yiři d mmi.

Maca inni ittcekkan, d lkuffar, d iɛeffanen, d imexmaj, d yinni ineqqen, d yinni iggin taseḥḥart, d ayt n farq-ccɣeř d yinni iɛebbden l’aṣnam d marra ayt n bu-ixarriqen, ad tiři tesɣart nsen di řebḥar ittcefcufen s tmessi d řecbareyyet, ta d řmewt wiss tnayen.”
Urcalim n jdid
Uca yusa-dd ijjen zi sebɛa n lmalakat, tinni ɣarsent sebɛa n ṭṭawyat ccurent s sebɛa n jjrayeḥ tineggura, issiweř akidi, inna:
“As-dd, ad ac ssecneɣ tasřit, tamɣart n Yezmar.”
Indeh ayi di Arruḥ ɣar ijj n wedrar d ameqqran yuɛřan aṭṭas uca isscen ayi tandint iqeddsen, Urcalim, am dd-tehwa zeg ujenna, zi zzat n AREBBI.
Aɛuǧi n AREBBI tuɣa ɣares, uca ṭṭya nnes tᵉttissiq am yiẓra iɣřan aṭṭas, am weẓru n yaspis nni dd-iḍharen am ukristal.
Iquwwar as dd ijj n weɣbar d ameqqran yuɛřa, ɣares tenɛac n tewwura u tenɛac n lmalakat tuɣa ttbeddant ɣar tiwwura. U ttwarin ismawen x tiwwura nni, aqa ismawen n tenɛac n tqebbař n Israil.
Aqa din třata n tewwura ɣar manis d tneqqar tfuct u ɣar ccamal třata n tewwura u ɣar ljanub třata n tewwura u aqa din třata n tewwura ɣar mani tɣeǧi tfuct.
Aɣbar n tendint ibedd x tenɛac n dsusa ttwarin xasen tenɛac n ismawen n rrusul n Mmis n AREBBI.
Wenni tuɣa akidi issawařen, ɣares ijj n uɣanim n řeɛbar ḥima ad zzayes iɛbar tandint d weɣbar nnes.

Tandint tuɣa temmars din am ijj n ukwadrun, tazuggart nnes am tiru nnes. Netta iɛbar tandint s uɣanim nnes n řeɛbar: tenɛac-ařef n ‘istadiyyen’, ɛřaḥař ařfayen u mitayen kilumitr. Tazuggart nnes d tiru nnes d řuɛřa nnes d icten.
Iɛbar aɣbar nnes: mya u-arebɛa u-rebɛin n iɣaǧen, aqa-t d řqedd n ijj n bnadem, aqa-t n lmalak.
Aɣbar nnes ggin t s yaspis, u tandint ggint s wureɣ iṣfan, ittban am zzaj iṣfan.
Dsusa n weɣbar n tendint tuɣa ttwazewwqen kuřci s iẓra iɣřan. Tuɣa dsas amezwaru n weẓru n yaspis, wenni wiss tnayen n ṣaffir, wenni wiss třata n xalcidun, wenni wiss arebɛa n smiralda,

wenni d wiss xemsa n sarduniks, wenni wiss setta n sardiyus, wenni wiss sebɛa n weẓru n wureɣ, wenni wiss tmenya n biril, wenni wiss tesɛa n tupas, wenni wiss ɛecra n krisupras, wenni wiss ḥiṭac n yazint uca wenni wiss tenɛac n umetist.
Tenɛac n tewwura d tenɛac n tyaqutin, ict ict. Kuř icten zi tewwura nni tuɣa zeg ict n tyaqut. Maca abrid yiriwen n tendint tuɣa-t n wureɣ iṣfan, am zzaj iṣfan.
War ẓriɣ ca Zzawect dayes minzi SIDI AREBBI, Amzemmar x kuřci, Netta Simant nnes d Zzawect nnes.
Izmar d tendint war ḥdajen ca tafuct uřa d taziri, ḥima ad xas ssarɣent, minzi aɛuǧi n AREBBI yareqq dayes uca Izmar d Řefnar nnes.
Řegnus ad uyuren s tfawt nnes uca ijeǧiden n temmurt ad ɣares ssidfen aɛuǧi nsen.
Tiwwura nnes war ttwaqqnent ɛemmarṣ s uziř, minzi ǧiřet war tᵉttɣimi ca din.
Nitni ad awyen ɣares aɛuǧi d ccan n řegnus.
Ɛemmarṣ ad dayes tadef ca n řḥajjet tamengust niɣ wenni iggin nnɛawat niɣ wenni issxarriqen, mɣir inni ittwazemmemen deg Wedlis ittwanḍen n Yezmar waha.
